title: The Flatland Extending Toward Uniformity

features.name: the horizon's standing stone
features.desc-on-touch: A single marker, far across the plain. You walk toward it. The distance never changes. The flatness teaches that arrival and departure are the same direction.

features.name: the dream-fence
features.desc-on-touch: A fence running parallel to your walking, neither approaching nor receding. Posts repeated endlessly. You can see through it but not cross it. The fence is the flatness teaching itself geometry.

features.name: the paddock's self-repeating pattern
features.desc-on-touch: Where the ground itself becomes the proof. Same grass, same dirt, same angle of light, cycling back to the beginning. The country dreams in loops.

features.name: the edge you cannot leave
features.desc-on-touch: The flatness continues. It has learned it doesn't need boundaries. Every direction is the same soft light, the same breathing earth, the same dream.

inscription: uniformity learned that endless returning was itself a kind of motion
